header.notes: Organization: Banff, Yoho and Kootenay National Parks. Observer: Ian Jackson. Snowpit depth 115 cm; Snowpack depth 115 cm. Date printed '2015-12-13 1:00 pm'. Slope, Aspect, Blowing snow and Ski Pen. (PS) printed '--'. Surface (hatched row above HS): + 3 mm (no water content). Notes: 'First trip up to SImpson plot this season. Interval board needed at some point. Dec. 3rd layer obvious in pit wall and some whumphing at helipad. Seems to be limited to between 2150 m and 1700 m based on multiple observations on ski up and out. Below 1700 m it has been rained on, above 2150 m it was above inversion and didn't form. Rugged skiing out bottom of Simpson 1 with thick alders.' Chart id 566DFCE4F122870F009CD5FB.

transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster (surface line y=299.5, 0 cm y=2751.5, 21.32 px/cm); boundaries printed on the right axis and every bar edge agrees with them. Hardness from bar left edges vs gridlines (I/K/P/1F/4F/F at 707/967/1227/1487/1747/2007 px, 260 px per class; thirds as +/-). Temperatures are break points of the unmarked red polyline (Douglas-Peucker on the line centre, +-0.1 C / +-0.5 cm), calibrated with x = 2115.5 + 46.80*T(C). Dashed air-temperature segment rises from the surface toward the printed -4.0 C (not recorded as snow temperature). Break points at 105.3 and 69.8 cm rounded to 105 and 70. Thin layers 78-77, 77-73, 73-72 drawn taller in the grain table; heights from the right-axis labels and bar edges. Water content column blank for all layers; no density column. Placement of 'Dec. 3rd Layer' on the 78-77 SH layer (not the 77-73 layer whose top is at the leader) follows the rule that labels naming a drawn layer go on that layer.
